title: poa angustifolia var. sublanata
intro: Poa angustifolia var. sublanata, commonly known as Salt River Bluegrass, is a perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of North America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Salt River Bluegrass include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Poa angustifolia var. sublanata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing.
